Dear Hiring Committee,


I am applying for the J0626-0462 - Medical Writer, Scientific Projects, at the Pre-Awards Office at the RI-MUHC. I have ample scientific writing experience and significant experience in grant writing, which I believe make me an ideal candidate for the position.

I have gained scientific writing writing skills during my doctoral and postdoctoral training, as I have written and collaborated in multiple research projects in preclinical or clinical research. This allows me to have a broad understanding of target audiences for each project, and the tone and style of writing required, which is essential for grant writing as well. I should mention that in every project where I have been the first author, I have been responsible for writing, editing, and submitting each manuscript.

My grant writing experience involves projects in the US and Canada. In the US, I wrote a successful proposal for the Arkansas Biosciences Institute to secure funding for the last aim of my doctoral dissertation. This proposal scored as the top 2 of the proposal submitted for the cycle and allowed me to obtain US 30,000 in funding. In Canada, during my postdoc at Université de Montréal, I was co-investigator in a grant submitted to the CIHR. My collaboration in this grant involved significant writing duties, revising and editing the proposal, and managing input of other co-investigators to create a cohesive and compelling narrative. This allowed me to gain significant experience with the Canadian grant system and managing collaborative writing projects within a tight deadline.

Medical and scientific writing is something I enjoy, and I look forward to work and collaborate with researchers and clinicians in the writing of high-impact grant proposals. It is for this reason that I believe I would be an ideal candidate for the advertised position.


Thank you for considering my application. I welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications further.

Sincerely,
